instruments.title: Add Finansforetaksloven, LOV-2015-04-10-17
instruments.sourceLabel: Lovdata, lov 10. april 2015 nr. 17 om finansforetak og finanskonsern (finansforetaksloven), consolidated text

titles.en: Act on Financial Undertakings and Financial Groups (Financial Undertakings Act)

payload.implementsNote: CRD, Directive 2013/36/EU; BRRD, Directive 2014/59/EU; PSD2, Directive (EU) 2015/2366; E-Money Directive 2009/110/EC; Solvency II, Directive 2009/138/EC; IORP II, Directive (EU) 2016/2341; Securitisation Regulation (EU) 2017/2402

obligations.title: Add the duty: Appoint only suitable board members, managers and key function holders

titles.en: Appoint only suitable board members, managers and key function holders

summaries.en: A financial undertaking may not have board members, a chief executive or others in its actual management who cannot be expected to have the qualifications and experience the role needs, or whose criminal record or earlier conduct gives reason to believe they cannot carry out the role soundly. The same test applies to other persons holding key functions in the undertaking.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Outsource only non-core tasks, soundly, and keep full responsibility for them

titles.en: Outsource only non-core tasks, soundly, and keep full responsibility for them

summaries.en: A financial undertaking may have another firm carry out parts of its business that are not core tasks, but not to an extent or in a way that is unsound or that makes supervision of the outsourced activity or of the undertaking harder. Using a service provider does not reduce the undertaking's own duties and liability towards customers, authorities and others.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Organise and run the undertaking soundly with clear governance and risk procedures

titles.en: Organise and run the undertaking soundly with clear governance and risk procedures

summaries.en: The undertaking must be organised and run soundly, with a clear organisational structure and allocation of responsibilities, clear and appropriate governance and control arrangements, and policies and procedures to identify, manage, monitor and report the risks it is or may be exposed to. Its network and information systems must meet the DORA Regulation (EU) 2022/2554, and its arrangements must be proportionate to the risk and scale of the business.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Maintain independent internal audit, risk management and compliance functions

titles.en: Maintain independent internal audit, risk management and compliance functions

summaries.en: The undertaking must have independent control functions responsible for internal audit, risk management and compliance with the requirements set in or under statute. Insurers and pension undertakings must also have an independent actuarial function.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Conduct the business with integrity and good business practice

titles.en: Conduct the business with integrity and good business practice

summaries.en: The undertaking must carry on its business honestly and in line with good business practice in all its dealings.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Let employees report breaches internally or to the authorities

titles.en: Let employees report breaches internally or to the authorities

summaries.en: The undertaking must make arrangements so that its employees can report breaches of rules set in or under statute, both internally and to the authorities.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Assess the business's risks and total capital need regularly, with a board risk committee

titles.en: Assess the business's risks and total capital need regularly, with a board risk committee

summaries.en: The undertaking must at all times have an overview of, and regularly assess, the individual risks and the total risk of its business, including credit, liquidity, funding, market, operational and systemic risk, and hold capital that is sound for that risk. It must assess its capital need in the short and longer term and how to meet it; the board must monitor overall risk and whether governance fits the risk, and a risk committee of non-executive board members, appointed by the board, prepares the board's work unless an exemption is granted.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Hold enough liquid assets to meet obligations as they fall due

titles.en: Hold enough liquid assets to meet obligations as they fall due

summaries.en: The undertaking must ensure that it always has sufficient liquid assets to meet its obligations when they fall due, and manage liquidity soundly under guidelines set by the board. Banks, credit institutions and finance companies must report the remaining maturity of balance-sheet items and off-balance-sheet financial instruments to Finanstilsynet.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report own funds, capital requirements and risk information to Finanstilsynet

titles.en: Report own funds, capital requirements and risk information to Finanstilsynet

summaries.en: The undertaking must report to Finanstilsynet on its own funds, its capital requirements and other matters needed to assess the risk in its business, in line with the detailed reporting rules set by regulation.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Hold the minimum own funds and the combined capital buffers at all times

titles.en: Hold the minimum own funds and the combined capital buffers at all times

summaries.en: Banks, credit institutions and finance companies, and holding companies of groups that include them, must at all times hold common equity tier 1 capital of at least 4.5 per cent of the calculation basis under § 14-2, as part of the minimum own funds requirement. On top of the minimum they must hold the buffers the Act sets in common equity tier 1 capital, including a 2.5 per cent capital conservation buffer and a systemic risk buffer.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Have a remuneration scheme that supports sound risk management

titles.en: Have a remuneration scheme that supports sound risk management

summaries.en: The undertaking must have and apply a remuneration scheme covering all employees and elected officers, with specific rules for senior management, staff whose work affects its risk exposure and staff in control roles. The scheme must match its objectives, risk tolerance and long-term interests, promote good management and control of risk and not encourage excessive risk-taking, and the undertaking must have procedures to implement, monitor and regularly review it; the detailed requirements are set by regulation.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep customers' business and personal information confidential

titles.en: Keep customers' business and personal information confidential

summaries.en: The undertaking must prevent unauthorised persons from gaining access to or knowledge of information about customers' and others' business or personal affairs that it receives in its business, unless a statute or regulation requires or allows it to disclose the information.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Accept cash from customers and make deposits available in cash

titles.en: Accept cash from customers and make deposits available in cash

summaries.en: A bank must, in line with its customers' expectations and needs, accept cash from customers and make their deposits available to them in cash. The detailed duty may be set by the ministry in regulation.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Inform depositors in writing about the deposit guarantee scheme that covers them

titles.en: Inform depositors in writing about the deposit guarantee scheme that covers them

summaries.en: A bank or other financial undertaking taking deposits in Norway must tell its customers in writing which deposit guarantee scheme applies and what cover it gives. The information must be in Norwegian and easy to understand, and may be given electronically to online banking customers unless they ask for paper.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell customers the interest rates, fees and other prices of services and bundles

titles.en: Tell customers the interest rates, fees and other prices of services and bundles

summaries.en: The undertaking must inform customers of interest rates, commissions and other prices for its services. Where services are sold as a package, it must say which of them are also offered separately and state the price of each service in the package.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep a board-approved recovery plan, update it yearly and send it to Finanstilsynet

titles.en: Keep a board-approved recovery plan, update it yearly and send it to Finanstilsynet

summaries.en: The undertaking must have a plan setting out the measures it can take to restore its financial position if it is significantly weakened. The plan must be updated every year, more often if Finanstilsynet requires or when changes in the undertaking call for it, approved by the board and sent to Finanstilsynet.

instruments.title: Add Verdipapirhandelloven, LOV-2007-06-29-75
instruments.sourceLabel: Lovdata, lov 29. juni 2007 nr. 75 om verdipapirhandel (verdipapirhandelloven), consolidated text

titles.en: Act on Securities Trading (Securities Trading Act)

payload.implementsNote: MiFID II, Directive 2014/65/EU; makes MAR, Regulation (EU) No 596/2014 (§ 3-1), the Short Selling Regulation (EU) No 236/2012 (§ 3-5) and MiFIR, Regulation (EU) No 600/2014 (§ 8-1) Norwegian law

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not deal on, recommend on or unlawfully disclose inside information
obligations.sourceLabel: Lovdata, verdipapirhandelloven (LOV-2007-06-29-75) § 3-1, which makes MAR Norwegian law; duty read at EUR-Lex, Regulation (EU) No 596/2014, Article 14

titles.en: Do not deal on, recommend on or unlawfully disclose inside information

summaries.en: No person may engage or attempt to engage in insider dealing, recommend or induce another person to engage in insider dealing, or unlawfully disclose inside information. The Market Abuse Regulation applies in Norway as law through § 3-1, with Finanstilsynet as the competent authority.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not engage in or attempt market manipulation
obligations.sourceLabel: Lovdata, verdipapirhandelloven (LOV-2007-06-29-75) § 3-1, which makes MAR Norwegian law; duty read at EUR-Lex, Regulation (EU) No 596/2014, Article 15

titles.en: Do not engage in or attempt market manipulation

summaries.en: No person may engage in or attempt to engage in market manipulation of financial instruments. The prohibition applies through § 3-1, which makes the Market Abuse Regulation Norwegian law.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Detect suspicious orders and transactions and report them to Finanstilsynet without delay
obligations.sourceLabel: Lovdata, verdipapirhandelloven (LOV-2007-06-29-75) § 3-1, which makes MAR Norwegian law; duty read at EUR-Lex, Regulation (EU) No 596/2014, Article 16

titles.en: Detect suspicious orders and transactions and report them to Finanstilsynet without delay

summaries.en: A firm that professionally arranges or executes transactions must have effective arrangements, systems and procedures to detect and report suspicious orders and transactions. When it reasonably suspects that an order or transaction, on or off a trading venue, could be insider dealing or market manipulation or an attempt at either, it must notify the competent authority, which in Norway is Finanstilsynet, without delay.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Disclose inside information that directly concerns the issuer as soon as possible
obligations.sourceLabel: Lovdata, verdipapirhandelloven (LOV-2007-06-29-75) § 3-1, which makes MAR Norwegian law; duty read at EUR-Lex, Regulation (EU) No 596/2014, Article 17

titles.en: Disclose inside information that directly concerns the issuer as soon as possible

summaries.en: An issuer whose financial instruments are admitted to trading on a regulated market, or traded on an MTF or OTF at its request or with its approval, must make inside information that directly concerns it public as soon as possible, in a way that allows fast access and a complete, correct and timely assessment. It must not combine the disclosure with marketing, must keep the disclosed information on its website for at least five years, and may delay disclosure only on its own responsibility when all the conditions of Article 17(4) are met.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep an up-to-date insider list and give it to Finanstilsynet on request
obligations.sourceLabel: Lovdata, verdipapirhandelloven (LOV-2007-06-29-75) § 3-1, which makes MAR Norwegian law; duty read at EUR-Lex, Regulation (EU) No 596/2014, Article 18

titles.en: Keep an up-to-date insider list and give it to Finanstilsynet on request

summaries.en: An issuer, or anyone acting on its behalf, must draw up a list of all persons working for it who have access to inside information, update it promptly and provide it to the competent authority as soon as possible on request. The list must show at least each person's identity, why they are on it, when they got access and when the list was drawn up, and the issuer must take reasonable steps to make listed persons acknowledge their duties in writing.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Notify managers' own-account dealings in the issuer's instruments within three business days
obligations.sourceLabel: Lovdata, verdipapirhandelloven (LOV-2007-06-29-75) § 3-1, which makes MAR Norwegian law; duty read at EUR-Lex, Regulation (EU) No 596/2014, Article 19

titles.en: Notify managers' own-account dealings in the issuer's instruments within three business days

summaries.en: Persons discharging managerial responsibilities in an issuer, and persons closely associated with them, must notify the issuer and the competent authority of their own-account transactions in the issuer's shares, debt instruments and linked instruments promptly and no later than three business days after the transaction once the yearly threshold is reached, and must not trade in the 30 calendar days before an interim or year-end report. The issuer must tell these persons of their duties in writing and keep a list of them; in Norway a cohabitant in a marriage-like relationship counts as a spouse (§ 3-3).

obligations.title: Add the duty: Present investment recommendations objectively and disclose interests and conflicts
obligations.sourceLabel: Lovdata, verdipapirhandelloven (LOV-2007-06-29-75) § 3-1, which makes MAR Norwegian law; duty read at EUR-Lex, Regulation (EU) No 596/2014, Article 20

titles.en: Present investment recommendations objectively and disclose interests and conflicts

summaries.en: Anyone who produces or disseminates investment recommendations or other information recommending or suggesting an investment strategy must take reasonable care that the information is objectively presented and must disclose their interests or conflicts of interest concerning the financial instruments it relates to.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Notify Finanstilsynet of significant net short positions in shares
obligations.sourceLabel: Lovdata, verdipapirhandelloven (LOV-2007-06-29-75) § 3-5, which makes the Short Selling Regulation Norwegian law; duty read at EUR-Lex, Regulation (EU) No 236/2012, Article 5

titles.en: Notify Finanstilsynet of significant net short positions in shares

summaries.en: A natural or legal person holding a net short position in the issued share capital of a company whose shares are admitted to trading on a trading venue must notify the competent authority each time the position reaches or falls below a notification threshold. The Short Selling Regulation (EU) No 236/2012 applies as Norwegian law through § 3-5.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Use no unreasonable business methods and follow good business practice when promoting trading

titles.en: Use no unreasonable business methods and follow good business practice when promoting trading

summaries.en: No one may use unreasonable business methods when trading in financial instruments. Approaches to the public or to individuals that offer or invite the purchase, sale or subscription of financial instruments, or otherwise aim to promote trading in them, must follow good business practice; the rule covers financial instruments with a connection to Norway.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Identify, prevent or manage conflicts of interest and disclose those that remain

titles.en: Identify, prevent or manage conflicts of interest and disclose those that remain

summaries.en: A firm providing investment services must take all appropriate steps to identify and to prevent or manage conflicts of interest between itself and its clients and between clients, including conflicts caused by payments from others than the client or by its own remuneration and incentive schemes. Where its organisational measures cannot ensure with reasonable confidence that the client's interests will not be harmed, it must clearly disclose the possible conflicts to the client.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Assess appropriateness for non-advised services and warn the client when it is lacking

titles.en: Assess appropriateness for non-advised services and warn the client when it is lacking

summaries.en: When providing investment services other than advice or portfolio management, the firm must seek information on the client's knowledge and experience so that it can judge whether the service or product is appropriate. If it judges it inappropriate, or the client gives no or incomplete information, it must warn the client; execution-only services in non-complex instruments at the client's initiative are exempt when the client is told that no assessment is made.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Accept or pay third-party inducements only when they improve the service, and disclose them

titles.en: Accept or pay third-party inducements only when they improve the service, and disclose them

summaries.en: In connection with investment or ancillary services, the firm may not receive payments from, or make payments to, anyone other than the client unless the payment is designed to improve the quality of the service to the client and does not impair the firm's duty to act honestly, fairly and professionally in the client's best interests. Before the service is provided, the client must receive accurate, complete and understandable information about such payments.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Take sufficient steps to obtain the best possible result when executing client orders

titles.en: Take sufficient steps to obtain the best possible result when executing client orders

summaries.en: When executing client orders the firm must take sufficient steps to obtain the best possible result for the client; for retail clients the result is judged on the total consideration of price and all costs of execution. The firm must have an order execution policy, inform clients of it and obtain their consent, obtain express consent before executing outside a trading venue, and monitor and review its execution arrangements.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Record telephone conversations and keep electronic communications for at least five years

titles.en: Record telephone conversations and keep electronic communications for at least five years

summaries.en: The firm's documentation of its investment business must include recordings of telephone conversations and storage of electronic communications as § 9-17 requires. The records must be kept for at least five years, or longer if Finanstilsynet so decides.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Run a product approval process for instruments made for clients and review what is offered

titles.en: Run a product approval process for instruments made for clients and review what is offered

summaries.en: A firm that manufactures financial instruments for sale to clients must have an appropriate approval process for each instrument, including its intended target market, and must give distributors all relevant information on the instrument and the approval process. Firms must also regularly review the instruments they offer or market, taking account of events that could materially affect the risk to the target market, to check that they still meet its needs.

instruments.title: Add Hvitvaskingsloven, LOV-2018-06-01-23
instruments.sourceLabel: Lovdata, lov 1. juni 2018 nr. 23 om tiltak mot hvitvasking og terrorfinansiering (hvitvaskingsloven), consolidated text

titles.nb: Lov om tiltak mot hvitvasking og terrorfinansiering (hvitvaskingsloven)
titles.en: Act on Measures against Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing (Anti-Money Laundering Act)

payload.implementsNote: AMLD4, Directive (EU) 2015/849; makes the Transfer of Funds Regulation (EU) 2023/1113 Norwegian law (§ 52)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Identify and assess the money laundering and terrorist financing risk of the business

titles.en: Identify and assess the money laundering and terrorist financing risk of the business

summaries.en: The firm must identify and assess the money laundering and terrorist financing risk of its business, taking account of the nature and scale of the business, its products, services and customer relationships, its types of customers and geographic factors. It must assess the risk specifically before offering new products or services or using new technology, and document the assessment, keep it up to date and make it available to the supervisor.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep up-to-date AML procedures set at the highest level with a named manager responsible

titles.en: Keep up-to-date AML procedures set at the highest level with a named manager responsible

summaries.en: The firm must have up-to-date procedures that manage the identified risk and meet the Act's duties, adapted to the nature and scale of the business, documented and available to the supervisor. The procedures must be adopted at the highest level of the firm, a named person in management must be responsible for following them up, and in groups they apply at group level and in branches and majority-owned subsidiaries.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Carry out customer due diligence when onboarding, above the transaction thresholds and on suspicion

titles.en: Carry out customer due diligence when onboarding, above the transaction thresholds and on suspicion

summaries.en: The firm must carry out customer due diligence when it establishes a customer relationship; for transactions for persons who are not customers of at least NOK 100,000, with lower thresholds for certain money transfers and some reporting entities; on suspicion of money laundering or terrorist financing; and for transfers where Regulation (EU) 2023/1113 requires it. Transactions that appear linked are added together for the thresholds.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Obtain and verify the identity of customers and of those acting for them

titles.en: Obtain and verify the identity of customers and of those acting for them

summaries.en: For a natural person the firm must obtain the name, national identity number or D number (or date and place of birth, sex and nationality) and address, and verify the identity with valid identification at a personal meeting or with extra documentation or measures when onboarding remotely; the same applies to anyone acting for the customer or holding authority over an account. For a legal person it must obtain its name, legal form, organisation number, address and the names of its general manager and board members, verify them against a public register or a company certificate no older than three months, and take appropriate, documented measures to understand its ownership and control structure.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Identify the customer's beneficial owners and verify their identity

titles.en: Identify the customer's beneficial owners and verify their identity

summaries.en: The firm must determine whether there are beneficial owners besides the customer, such as natural persons who own or control more than 25 per cent of a legal person or otherwise control it, obtain enough information to know who they are and verify their identity with appropriate measures.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Apply enhanced due diligence where the risk of money laundering is high

titles.en: Apply enhanced due diligence where the risk of money laundering is high

summaries.en: Where there is a high risk of money laundering or terrorist financing, the firm must carry out enhanced customer due diligence: beyond the ordinary identification and verification it must take further measures needed to know the customer, the beneficial owners and the purpose and intended nature of the relationship.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Apply enhanced measures to politically exposed persons, their family and close associates

titles.en: Apply enhanced measures to politically exposed persons, their family and close associates

summaries.en: When a customer, a person acting for the customer, a holder of account authority or a beneficial owner is a politically exposed person, or a close family member or known associate of one, the firm must apply enhanced due diligence, including senior approval before establishing or continuing the relationship and adequate measures to establish the source of wealth and funds. The measures continue for at least one year after the person left the position.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Vet respondent institutions outside the EEA and never deal with shell banks

titles.en: Vet respondent institutions outside the EEA and never deal with shell banks

summaries.en: Before entering a correspondent relationship with a respondent institution from outside the EEA, the firm must gather enough information to understand its business, reputation and supervision, assess its anti-money laundering controls, obtain senior approval, document each party's responsibilities and, for payable-through accounts, make sure the respondent has verified and monitors the customers with direct access. It must not enter into or keep a correspondent relationship with a shell bank.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not establish a relationship or carry out a transaction when due diligence cannot be completed

titles.en: Do not establish a relationship or carry out a transaction when due diligence cannot be completed

summaries.en: If customer due diligence, including any required enhanced measures, cannot be carried out, the firm must not establish the customer relationship or carry out the transaction, and must consider whether to investigate further and report under §§ 25 and 26.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Monitor customer relationships and transactions on an ongoing basis

titles.en: Monitor customer relationships and transactions on an ongoing basis

summaries.en: The firm must follow up customer relationships on an ongoing basis, including checking that transactions match what it knows about the customer, the customer's business and risk profile, the source of funds and the purpose of the relationship. It must repeat due diligence regularly and always when it doubts that information it holds is correct or sufficient.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Investigate unusual activity and report suspicions of money laundering to Økokrim

titles.en: Investigate unusual activity and report suspicions of money laundering to Økokrim

summaries.en: When the firm uncovers circumstances that may indicate that funds are linked to money laundering or terrorist financing, it must investigate further. If the investigation gives grounds for suspicion, it must send the information to Økokrim and answer Økokrim's requests for further information, and it must not carry out a suspicious transaction before Økokrim has been notified; if stopping it is impossible or could hinder the investigation, Økokrim must be told immediately afterwards.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not tell the customer or others about investigations or reports to Økokrim

titles.en: Do not tell the customer or others about investigations or reports to Økokrim

summaries.en: The firm and its staff must not make the customer or third parties aware of investigations, of information sent to Økokrim, or of police investigations, except for the disclosures the Act allows, such as to the prosecution authority or the firm's anti-money laundering supervisor, and exchanges between reporting entities in the same group established in the EEA.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep due diligence and monitoring records securely for five years and then delete personal data

titles.en: Keep due diligence and monitoring records securely for five years and then delete personal data

summaries.en: The firm must record and keep the information and documents obtained or prepared in customer due diligence, monitoring and investigations for five years after the relationship ended or the transaction was carried out, stored securely against unauthorised access. When the five years have passed the personal data must be deleted.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Ensure compliance through internal control and train staff regularly

titles.en: Ensure compliance through internal control and train staff regularly

summaries.en: The firm must ensure through internal control that the Act is complied with, and where a risk assessment of its size and nature calls for it, appoint a compliance officer, vet the suitability of employees and set up independent control of its procedures. It must give employees and others working for it regular training so that they know the firm's duties and can recognise signs of money laundering and terrorist financing.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Operate electronic monitoring systems to detect possible money laundering

titles.en: Operate electronic monitoring systems to detect possible money laundering

summaries.en: Banks, credit institutions and finance companies must have electronic monitoring systems to detect circumstances that may indicate money laundering or terrorist financing, unless Finanstilsynet grants an individual exemption.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Send the required payer and payee information with transfers and detect missing information
obligations.sourceLabel: Lovdata, hvitvaskingsloven (LOV-2018-06-01-23) § 52, which makes Regulation (EU) 2023/1113 Norwegian law; duty read at EUR-Lex, Regulation (EU) 2023/1113, Articles 4 and 7

titles.en: Send the required payer and payee information with transfers and detect missing information

summaries.en: As the payer's payment service provider the firm must ensure that transfers of funds carry the information on the payer that Regulation (EU) 2023/1113 requires, such as name, account number and address or an equivalent identifier; as the payee's provider it must have effective procedures to detect whether required information on the payer or payee is missing. The Regulation applies as Norwegian law through § 52, also for certain crypto-asset transfers.

instruments.title: Add Finansavtaleloven, LOV-2020-12-18-146
instruments.sourceLabel: Lovdata, LOV-2020-12-18-146, Lov om finansavtaler (finansavtaleloven), consolidated text

titles.en: Act on Financial Agreements (Financial Agreements Act)

payload.implementsNote: PSD2, Directive (EU) 2015/2366 (private-law parts); Payment Accounts Directive 2014/92/EU; Mortgage Credit Directive 2014/17/EU

obligations.title: Add the duty: Act honestly and professionally and match offers to the customer's needs

titles.en: Act honestly and professionally and match offers to the customer's needs

summaries.en: The provider must reasonably identify its own conflicts of interest, act honestly, fairly and professionally, and give clear information that is not misleading. Before an agreement is made it must identify the customer's demands and needs from information obtained from the customer, including the financial situation where relevant, make offers and recommendations that fit them, guide the customer between its products as needed, and give any personal recommendation in writing.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the terms and all relevant information in good time before the agreement

titles.en: Give the terms and all relevant information in good time before the agreement

summaries.en: Unless otherwise provided, the provider must give the customer the contract terms and all relevant information in good time before an agreement is made. The detailed information duties apply to all financial services sold at a distance and, whatever the sales channel, to account and payment service agreements, credit agreements and guarantees.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not refuse payment services without objective grounds and decide account requests within ten business days

titles.en: Do not refuse payment services without objective grounds and decide account requests within ten business days

summaries.en: A payment service provider may not refuse to provide payment services on ordinary terms without objective grounds, and may not make a consumer's payment account conditional on buying other services. A consumer's request for a payment account must be decided no later than ten business days after the provider has received the information it needs.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Bear losses from unauthorised payment transactions, subject to the customer's limited liability

titles.en: Bear losses from unauthorised payment transactions, subject to the customer's limited liability

summaries.en: The payment service provider is liable to the customer for losses caused by a payment transaction the customer did not authorise. The customer bears only the limited own risk and the liability for gross negligence or intent that § 4-30 sets out, and never losses caused by the provider or those acting for it.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Refund a disputed unauthorised transaction by the end of the next business day

titles.en: Refund a disputed unauthorised transaction by the end of the next business day

summaries.en: When a customer who notified in time disputes liability for an unauthorised payment transaction, the provider must refund the amount and the lost interest at once and at the latest by the end of the following business day. It may withhold the refund only when it has reasonable grounds to suspect fraud and brings legal action or a complaint to an approved complaints body within four weeks of the customer's written objection.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Offer consumers a clear, quick and secure payment account switching procedure

titles.en: Offer consumers a clear, quick and secure payment account switching procedure

summaries.en: The payment service provider must give consumers access to a clear, quick and secure procedure for switching payment accounts that is easy to use, and the receiving provider must carry out the switch once the consumer's authorisation has been received.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Explain a proposed credit agreement to the consumer before it is made

titles.en: Explain a proposed credit agreement to the consumer before it is made

summaries.en: Before a credit agreement is made, the lender must give a consumer adequate, tailored explanations of the main features of the credit offered, the effect of any terms on ancillary services and the consequences of default, and must reasonably satisfy itself that the explanations let the consumer judge whether the credit suits their needs and finances.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Assess the borrower's creditworthiness thoroughly before granting or increasing credit

titles.en: Assess the borrower's creditworthiness thoroughly before granting or increasing credit

summaries.en: Before a credit agreement is made, including a significant increase of the available credit, the lender must make a thorough assessment of the customer's ability to repay, based on sufficient and relevant information about income, assets, expenses and other financial obligations, obtained where necessary from debt information companies, the customer or database searches. It must also have any collateral that forms part of the assessment valued.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell the customer how the credit assessment is used and explain automated refusals

titles.en: Tell the customer how the credit assessment is used and explain automated refusals

summaries.en: When collecting information from the customer, the lender must explain that providing it is a condition for the assessment and the offer, and what happens if information is knowingly withheld or falsified. It must share the result of the assessment before the credit is paid out, and if it refuses an application on the basis of automated processing it must tell the customer without undue delay, including whether the refusal rests on a database search and what that search showed.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Refuse consumer credit the assessment shows the consumer is unlikely to repay

titles.en: Refuse consumer credit the assessment shows the consumer is unlikely to repay

summaries.en: The lender may make a credit agreement with a consumer only if the creditworthiness assessment shows it is probable that the consumer can meet the obligations on the terms offered. Sufficient ability to repay may not rest only on the value of the collateral, except for housing loans to finance renovation or construction of residential property.

instruments.title: Add Verdipapirfondloven, LOV-2011-11-25-44
instruments.sourceLabel: Lovdata, LOV-2011-11-25-44, Lov om verdipapirfond (verdipapirfondloven), consolidated text

titles.en: Act on Securities Funds (Securities Funds Act)

payload.implementsNote: UCITS Directive 2009/65/EC; makes the Securities Financing Transactions Regulation (EU) 2015/2365 and the Money Market Funds Regulation (EU) 2017/1131 Norwegian law

obligations.title: Add the duty: Organise the management company with sound controls and minimal conflicts of interest

titles.en: Organise the management company with sound controls and minimal conflicts of interest

summaries.en: A management company must organise its business, with regard to the funds it manages, with sound administrative and accounting procedures, control and security arrangements and internal control methods, including rules on staff personal transactions, and the board and chief executive must set internal guidelines for this. It must be organised so that the risk of conflicts between itself and clients, between clients, and between clients and funds or between funds is kept to a minimum.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Monitor and measure the risk of each fund's positions at all times

titles.en: Monitor and measure the risk of each fund's positions at all times

summaries.en: A management company must have risk management systems that at all times monitor and measure the risk of the positions and their contribution to the overall risk profile of each portfolio.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Have internal procedures for handling customer complaints

titles.en: Have internal procedures for handling customer complaints

summaries.en: A management company must have internal procedures for handling customer complaints.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Act with good business practice and put funds' and unitholders' interests first

titles.en: Act with good business practice and put funds' and unitholders' interests first

summaries.en: A management company must carry on its business in line with good business practice, acting fairly and correctly with due skill, care and diligence, and must seek to avoid conflicts of interest by putting the interests of the funds and unitholders before its own and by not favouring some funds or unitholders unfairly over others. The same applies to its employees and elected officers.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give investors the fund's key information before they subscribe

titles.en: Give investors the fund's key information before they subscribe

summaries.en: The management company, those acting on its behalf and others entitled to sell or advise on fund units must give investors the fund's key information before they subscribe for units; it may be given on a durable medium or through a website.

instruments.title: Add AIF-loven, LOV-2014-06-20-28
instruments.sourceLabel: Lovdata, LOV-2014-06-20-28, Lov om forvaltning av alternative investeringsfond (AIF-loven), consolidated text

titles.nb: Lov om forvaltning av alternative investeringsfond (AIF-loven)
titles.en: Act on the Management of Alternative Investment Funds (AIF Act)

payload.implementsNote: AIFMD, Directive 2011/61/EU; makes the EuVECA Regulation (EU) No 345/2013, the EuSEF Regulation (EU) No 346/2013, the ELTIF Regulation (EU) 2015/760 and the SFTR (EU) 2015/2365 Norwegian law

obligations.title: Add the duty: Manage alternative investment funds with good business practice

titles.en: Manage alternative investment funds with good business practice

summaries.en: An AIF manager must carry on its business in line with good business practice and safeguard the interests of investors, the funds and the integrity of the market, acting fairly and correctly with the skill, care and diligence needed and using the resources and procedures the business requires.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Identify, manage and monitor conflicts of interest in fund management

titles.en: Identify, manage and monitor conflicts of interest in fund management

summaries.en: An AIF manager must seek to avoid conflicts of interest and take all reasonable steps to identify, manage and monitor conflicts that arise in managing alternative investment funds, including those between the manager and its staff, the funds, their investors and its other clients.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep a risk management function separate from operations and manage each fund's risks

titles.en: Keep a risk management function separate from operations and manage each fund's risks

summaries.en: An AIF manager must have a risk management function that is separate from its operating units, and risk management systems that continuously identify, measure, manage and monitor all risks relevant to each fund's investment strategy.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Manage each fund's liquidity and stress test it regularly

titles.en: Manage each fund's liquidity and stress test it regularly

summaries.en: An AIF manager must have an appropriate liquidity management system for each fund it manages, except closed-ended funds that do not use leverage, with policies to monitor liquidity risk and keep the liquidity profile of the investments in line with the fund's obligations, and must regularly run stress tests in normal and exceptional conditions.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Value fund assets correctly and independently and calculate the NAV at least yearly

titles.en: Value fund assets correctly and independently and calculate the NAV at least yearly

summaries.en: An AIF manager must have policies for the correct and independent valuation of the assets of the funds it manages, and must calculate the value of the assets and the net asset value per unit regularly and at least once a year, more often for open-ended funds where their assets or dealing terms call for it.

instruments.title: Add Forsikringsavtaleloven, LOV-1989-06-16-69
instruments.sourceLabel: Lovdata, LOV-1989-06-16-69, Lov om forsikringsavtaler (forsikringsavtaleloven), consolidated text

titles.en: Act on Insurance Contracts (Insurance Contracts Act)

payload.implementsNote: IDD, Directive (EU) 2016/97, in part, through the amendments in force 1 July 2022

obligations.title: Add the duty: Act honestly, fairly and professionally and give clear, non-misleading information

titles.en: Act honestly, fairly and professionally and give clear, non-misleading information

summaries.en: An insurer, and an insurance intermediary to which the rules apply, must reasonably identify its own conflicts of interest and act honestly, fairly and professionally in the customer's interest, act with professional care, and give information that is clear and not misleading, in Norwegian or another agreed language, with prices in Norwegian kroner unless another currency is agreed.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Identify the customer's demands and needs before an insurance contract and offer only what fits

titles.en: Identify the customer's demands and needs before an insurance contract and offer only what fits

summaries.en: Before an insurance contract is made, the distributor must identify the customer's demands and needs from information obtained from the customer, including their finances where relevant, and offer and recommend only cover consistent with them, with guidance on alternative and additional cover. Where it gives a personal recommendation, it must give the customer a written document explaining why the recommended product best meets the customer's wishes and needs.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Base every insurance-based investment product offer on a suitable personal recommendation

titles.en: Base every insurance-based investment product offer on a suitable personal recommendation

summaries.en: Offers of insurance-based investment products must always rest on a personal recommendation. To give it, the distributor must obtain information on the customer's knowledge and experience, financial situation and investment objectives, including risk tolerance and ability to bear losses, and recommend only a product suited to the customer.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the prescribed pre-contract information, including the product information document

titles.en: Give the prescribed pre-contract information, including the product information document

summaries.en: In good time before an insurance contract is made, the distributor must give the customer the information §§ 1C-3 to 1C-10 require, or immediately after the contract where it was made at the customer's request by distance communication. For non-life insurance this includes a standardised insurance product information document drawn up by the product's manufacturer.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Handle customer complaints effectively and answer them in writing within set deadlines

titles.en: Handle customer complaints effectively and answer them in writing within set deadlines

summaries.en: The insurer must have appropriate and effective procedures for handling customers' complaints and claims, and make a written description of them, of the supervisor and of the approved complaints body available to customers. Complaints about breaches of the general duties must be answered in writing within a reasonable time, with a holding reply stating reasons and a new date if no final answer is ready within 15 business days (35 in exceptional cases).

instruments.title: Add Forsikringsformidlingsloven, LOV-2021-12-22-163
instruments.sourceLabel: Lovdata, LOV-2021-12-22-163, Lov om forsikringsformidling (forsikringsformidlingsloven), consolidated text

titles.en: Act on Insurance Mediation (Insurance Mediation Act)

payload.implementsNote: IDD, Directive (EU) 2016/97 as amended by Directive (EU) 2018/411

obligations.title: Add the duty: Intermediate insurance only with a broker licence or registration as an insurance agent

titles.en: Intermediate insurance only with a broker licence or registration as an insurance agent

summaries.en: Insurance intermediation may only be carried on by a firm licensed for insurance or reinsurance broking, or registered as an insurance agent or ancillary insurance agent in Finanstilsynet's register, unless statute provides otherwise.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Organise the intermediary soundly and keep evidence of compliance for five years

titles.en: Organise the intermediary soundly and keep evidence of compliance for five years

summaries.en: An insurance intermediary must be organised and run soundly, with a clear organisational structure and allocation of responsibility and appropriate risk management and internal control procedures. It must document its compliance fully enough for Finanstilsynet to check that the rules are followed and keep the documentation for at least five years.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Place client money at once in a client account separate from the firm's own money

titles.en: Place client money at once in a client account separate from the firm's own money

summaries.en: An insurance intermediary must immediately place client money in a client account kept separate from its own funds.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Minimise and manage conflicts of interest and disclose remaining ones before the contract

titles.en: Minimise and manage conflicts of interest and disclose remaining ones before the contract

summaries.en: An insurance intermediary must be organised so that the risk of conflicts between itself and its customers, or between customers, is kept to a minimum, and take all appropriate steps to identify and prevent or manage them. Where the risk to the customer cannot be prevented with reasonable certainty, it must clearly disclose the possible conflicts and the steps taken, on a durable medium and in good time before the contract is made.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Avoid pay and incentives that conflict with customers' interests and limit third-party payments

titles.en: Avoid pay and incentives that conflict with customers' interests and limit third-party payments

summaries.en: An insurance intermediary must not pay or assess its staff in a way that weakens its ability to act in the customer's best interest, such as incentives to recommend one product over a more suitable one. It may receive payments from or make payments to others than the customer only if they do not harm the quality of the service or its duty to act honestly, fairly and professionally in the customer's best interests.

instruments.title: Add Personopplysningsloven, LOV-2018-06-15-38
instruments.sourceLabel: Lovdata, LOV-2018-06-15-38, Lov om behandling av personopplysninger (personopplysningsloven), consolidated text

titles.en: Act on the Processing of Personal Data (Personal Data Act)

payload.implementsNote: GDPR, Regulation (EU) 2016/679, made Norwegian law by § 1

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep a record of the processing activities under the firm's responsibility
obligations.sourceLabel: Lovdata, personopplysningsloven (LOV-2018-06-15-38) § 1, which makes the GDPR Norwegian law; duty read at EUR-Lex, Regulation (EU) 2016/679, Article 30

titles.en: Keep a record of the processing activities under the firm's responsibility

summaries.en: As a controller, the firm must keep a record of the processing activities it is responsible for, including its contact details and those of its data protection officer, the purposes of processing, the categories of data subjects and personal data, and the categories of recipients. The GDPR applies as Norwegian law through § 1.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Notify personal data breaches to Datatilsynet within 72 hours
obligations.sourceLabel: Lovdata, personopplysningsloven (LOV-2018-06-15-38) § 1, which makes the GDPR Norwegian law; duty read at EUR-Lex, Regulation (EU) 2016/679, Article 33

titles.en: Notify personal data breaches to Datatilsynet within 72 hours

summaries.en: When a personal data breach occurs, the controller must notify the supervisory authority, which in Norway is Datatilsynet (§ 20), without undue delay and where feasible within 72 hours of becoming aware of it, unless the breach is unlikely to result in a risk to people's rights and freedoms; a later notification must give reasons for the delay.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Process national identity numbers only when secure identification is objectively needed

titles.en: Process national identity numbers only when secure identification is objectively needed

summaries.en: The firm may process national identity numbers and other unique means of identification only when there is an objective need for secure identification and the method is necessary to achieve it.

instruments.title: Add DORA-loven, LOV-2025-05-27-18
instruments.sourceLabel: Lovdata, LOV-2025-05-27-18, Lov om digital operasjonell motstandsdyktighet i finanssektoren (DORA-loven), consolidated text

titles.nb: Lov om digital operasjonell motstandsdyktighet i finanssektoren (DORA-loven)
titles.en: Act on Digital Operational Resilience in the Financial Sector (DORA Act)

payload.implementsNote: DORA, Regulation (EU) 2022/2554, made Norwegian law by § 1; Directive (EU) 2022/2556

obligations.title: Add the duty: Make the management body responsible for the ICT risk management framework
obligations.sourceLabel: Lovdata, DORA-loven (LOV-2025-05-27-18) § 1, which makes DORA Norwegian law; duty read at EUR-Lex, Regulation (EU) 2022/2554, Article 5

titles.en: Make the management body responsible for the ICT risk management framework

summaries.en: The firm must have an internal governance and control framework that ensures effective and prudent management of ICT risk. Its management body must define, approve, oversee and be responsible for the ICT risk management framework, bear the ultimate responsibility for ICT risk, set policies for the availability, authenticity, integrity and confidentiality of data, and set clear roles for ICT functions. DORA applies as Norwegian law through § 1.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Maintain a sound, comprehensive and documented ICT risk management framework
obligations.sourceLabel: Lovdata, DORA-loven (LOV-2025-05-27-18) § 1, which makes DORA Norwegian law; duty read at EUR-Lex, Regulation (EU) 2022/2554, Article 6

titles.en: Maintain a sound, comprehensive and documented ICT risk management framework

summaries.en: The firm must have a sound, comprehensive and well-documented ICT risk management framework as part of its overall risk management, with the strategies, policies, procedures, ICT protocols and tools needed to protect all information and ICT assets and the relevant physical components and infrastructure against damage and unauthorised access or use.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report major ICT-related incidents to Finanstilsynet
obligations.sourceLabel: Lovdata, DORA-loven (LOV-2025-05-27-18) § 1, which makes DORA Norwegian law; duty read at EUR-Lex, Regulation (EU) 2022/2554, Article 19

titles.en: Report major ICT-related incidents to Finanstilsynet

summaries.en: The firm must report major ICT-related incidents to the relevant competent authority, which is Finanstilsynet under § 3 of the Act, in the way Article 19(4) of DORA sets out.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Run a digital operational resilience testing programme
obligations.sourceLabel: Lovdata, DORA-loven (LOV-2025-05-27-18) § 1, which makes DORA Norwegian law; duty read at EUR-Lex, Regulation (EU) 2022/2554, Article 24

titles.en: Run a digital operational resilience testing programme

summaries.en: Unless it is a microenterprise, the firm must establish, maintain and review a sound and comprehensive digital operational resilience testing programme as part of its ICT risk management framework, to assess its preparedness for ICT-related incidents, find weaknesses and gaps, and promptly correct them.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep a register of all ICT third-party service arrangements and report on them yearly
obligations.sourceLabel: Lovdata, DORA-loven (LOV-2025-05-27-18) § 1, which makes DORA Norwegian law; duty read at EUR-Lex, Regulation (EU) 2022/2554, Article 28

titles.en: Keep a register of all ICT third-party service arrangements and report on them yearly

summaries.en: As part of its ICT risk management framework, the firm must maintain and update, at entity and where relevant sub-consolidated and consolidated level, a register of information on all contractual arrangements for ICT services from third-party providers, distinguishing those that support critical or important functions. It must report at least yearly to the competent authority on new arrangements, and remains fully responsible for its obligations when it uses ICT providers.

instruments.title: Add Kryptoeiendelsloven, LOV-2025-05-27-20
instruments.sourceLabel: Lovdata, LOV-2025-05-27-20, Lov om kryptoeiendeler (kryptoeiendelsloven), consolidated text

titles.en: Act on Crypto-Assets (Crypto-Assets Act)

payload.implementsNote: MiCA, Regulation (EU) 2023/1114, made Norwegian law by § 1

obligations.title: Add the duty: Notify Finanstilsynet at least 40 working days before first providing crypto-asset services
obligations.sourceLabel: Lovdata, kryptoeiendelsloven (LOV-2025-05-27-20) § 1, which makes MiCA Norwegian law; duty read at EUR-Lex, Regulation (EU) 2023/1114, Article 60

titles.en: Notify Finanstilsynet at least 40 working days before first providing crypto-asset services

summaries.en: A credit institution may provide crypto-asset services if it notifies the competent authority of its home state, Finanstilsynet for a Norwegian bank, of the information MiCA Article 60(7) lists at least 40 working days before providing those services for the first time.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Detect market abuse in crypto-assets and report suspicious orders and transactions without delay
obligations.sourceLabel: Lovdata, kryptoeiendelsloven (LOV-2025-05-27-20) § 1, which makes MiCA Norwegian law; duty read at EUR-Lex, Regulation (EU) 2023/1114, Article 92

titles.en: Detect market abuse in crypto-assets and report suspicious orders and transactions without delay

summaries.en: A firm that professionally arranges or executes transactions in crypto-assets must have effective arrangements, systems and procedures to prevent and detect market abuse, and must report to the competent authority without delay any reasonable suspicion that an order or transaction, or aspects of the distributed ledger's functioning, indicate market abuse.

instruments.title: Add Digitalsikkerhetsloven, LOV-2023-12-20-108
instruments.sourceLabel: Lovdata, LOV-2023-12-20-108, Lov om digital sikkerhet (digitalsikkerhetsloven), consolidated text

titles.en: Act on Digital Security (Digital Security Act)

instruments.title: Add PRIIPs-loven, LOV-2024-06-21-40
instruments.sourceLabel: Lovdata, LOV-2024-06-21-40, Lov om nøkkelinformasjon om sammensatte og forsikringsbaserte investeringsprodukter (PRIIPs-loven), consolidated text

titles.nb: Lov om nøkkelinformasjon om sammensatte og forsikringsbaserte investeringsprodukter (PRIIPs-loven)
titles.en: Act on Key Information about Packaged and Insurance-based Investment Products (PRIIPs Act)

payload.implementsNote: PRIIPs Regulation (EU) No 1286/2014, as amended by Regulations (EU) 2016/2340, 2019/1156 and 2021/2259, made Norwegian law by § 2

obligations.title: Add the duty: Draw up and publish a key information document before a PRIIP is offered to retail investors
obligations.sourceLabel: Lovdata, PRIIPs-loven (LOV-2024-06-21-40) § 2, which makes the PRIIPs Regulation Norwegian law; duty read at EUR-Lex, Regulation (EU) No 1286/2014, Article 5

titles.en: Draw up and publish a key information document before a PRIIP is offered to retail investors

summaries.en: Before a packaged retail or insurance-based investment product is made available to retail investors, its manufacturer must draw up a key information document that meets the Regulation and publish it on its website. A key information document distributed in Norway must be in Norwegian, unless the ministry makes an exception by regulation (§ 4).

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give retail investors the key information document in good time before they are bound
obligations.sourceLabel: Lovdata, PRIIPs-loven (LOV-2024-06-21-40) § 2, which makes the PRIIPs Regulation Norwegian law; duty read at EUR-Lex, Regulation (EU) No 1286/2014, Article 13

titles.en: Give retail investors the key information document in good time before they are bound

summaries.en: A firm that advises on or sells a packaged retail or insurance-based investment product must provide retail investors with the key information document in good time before they are bound by any contract or offer relating to the product.

instruments.title: Add Lov om offentliggjøring av bærekraftsinformasjon i finanssektoren mv., LOV-2021-12-22-161
instruments.sourceLabel: Lovdata, LOV-2021-12-22-161, Lov om offentliggjøring av bærekraftsinformasjon i finanssektoren og et rammeverk for bærekraftige investeringer, consolidated text

titles.nb: Lov om offentliggjøring av bærekraftsinformasjon i finanssektoren og et rammeverk for bærekraftige investeringer
titles.en: Act on Disclosure of Sustainability Information in the Financial Sector and a Framework for Sustainable Investments

payload.shortName: Lov om offentliggjøring av bærekraftsinformasjon i finanssektoren mv.
payload.implementsNote: SFDR, Regulation (EU) 2019/2088 (§ 2), and the Taxonomy Regulation (EU) 2020/852 (§ 3), made Norwegian law

obligations.title: Add the duty: Publish on the website how sustainability risks are integrated in investment decisions or advice
obligations.sourceLabel: Lovdata, lov om offentliggjøring av bærekraftsinformasjon i finanssektoren mv. (LOV-2021-12-22-161) § 2, which makes SFDR Norwegian law; duty read at EUR-Lex, Regulation (EU) 2019/2088, Article 3

titles.en: Publish on the website how sustainability risks are integrated in investment decisions or advice

summaries.en: Financial market participants must publish on their websites their policies on integrating sustainability risks into investment decisions, and financial advisers their policies on integrating them into investment or insurance advice. Under § 2 the Regulation also applies to insurance intermediaries and investment firms.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Publish a statement on principal adverse sustainability impacts, or explain why they are not considered
obligations.sourceLabel: Lovdata, lov om offentliggjøring av bærekraftsinformasjon i finanssektoren mv. (LOV-2021-12-22-161) § 2, which makes SFDR Norwegian law; duty read at EUR-Lex, Regulation (EU) 2019/2088, Article 4

titles.en: Publish a statement on principal adverse sustainability impacts, or explain why they are not considered

summaries.en: Financial market participants must publish and keep on their websites either a statement on their due diligence policies for the principal adverse impacts of investment decisions on sustainability factors, or clear reasons why they do not consider such impacts and whether and when they intend to.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Describe in pre-contractual disclosures how sustainability risks are integrated and their likely impact
obligations.sourceLabel: Lovdata, lov om offentliggjøring av bærekraftsinformasjon i finanssektoren mv. (LOV-2021-12-22-161) § 2, which makes SFDR Norwegian law; duty read at EUR-Lex, Regulation (EU) 2019/2088, Article 6

titles.en: Describe in pre-contractual disclosures how sustainability risks are integrated and their likely impact

summaries.en: Financial market participants must describe in pre-contractual disclosures how sustainability risks are integrated into their investment decisions and the likely impact of those risks on the returns of their products, and financial advisers how they are integrated into their advice; where the risks are deemed not relevant, the disclosure must briefly explain why.

instruments.title: Add Finanstilsynsloven, LOV-2024-06-21-41
instruments.sourceLabel: Lovdata, LOV-2024-06-21-41, Lov om Finanstilsynet (finanstilsynsloven), consolidated text

titles.en: Act on the Financial Supervisory Authority of Norway (Financial Supervision Act)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give Finanstilsynet all information it requires, in the form it sets

titles.en: Give Finanstilsynet all information it requires, in the form it sets

summaries.en: A firm under supervision must give Finanstilsynet all the information it requires and hand over documents and information in the way Finanstilsynet sets. The duty applies notwithstanding confidentiality.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Alert Finanstilsynet quickly to matters that may threaten the firm's continued operation

titles.en: Alert Finanstilsynet quickly to matters that may threaten the firm's continued operation

summaries.en: A firm under supervision must inform Finanstilsynet as quickly as possible of matters that may be decisive for whether its business can continue.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Notify Finanstilsynet at least 60 days before outsourcing critical or important activities

titles.en: Notify Finanstilsynet at least 60 days before outsourcing critical or important activities

summaries.en: A firm under supervision must notify Finanstilsynet when it enters into or changes an agreement to outsource activities that are critical or important for it, at least 60 days before the agreement or change takes effect. Finanstilsynet may set conditions, or order the firm not to implement or to end the agreement, if the outsourcing is unsound or hinders supervision.

instruments.title: Add Betalingssystemloven, LOV-1999-12-17-95
instruments.sourceLabel: Lovdata, LOV-1999-12-17-95, Lov om betalingssystemer m.v. (betalingssystemloven), consolidated text

titles.en: Act on Payment Systems etc. (Payment Systems Act)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Notify Finanstilsynet without undue delay when establishing and operating a payment services system

titles.en: Notify Finanstilsynet without undue delay when establishing and operating a payment services system

summaries.en: An institution that establishes and operates a system for payment services must notify Finanstilsynet without undue delay, with the information the section lists, such as the agreements that govern the system and the authentication methods used.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give payment institutions access to payment account services on fair terms and justify refusals

titles.en: Give payment institutions access to payment account services on fair terms and justify refusals

summaries.en: A credit institution must give payment institutions access to its payment account services on objective, non-discriminatory and proportionate terms, to the extent they need to provide payment services effectively. If it refuses access, it must notify the supervisory authority and give its reasons.

instruments.title: Add Skatteforvaltningsloven, LOV-2016-05-27-14
instruments.sourceLabel: Lovdata, LOV-2016-05-27-14, Lov om skatteforvaltning (skatteforvaltningsloven), consolidated text

titles.en: Act on Tax Administration (Tax Administration Act)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report customers' deposits, loans, investments and insurance to the tax authorities

titles.en: Report customers' deposits, loans, investments and insurance to the tax authorities

summaries.en: Banks and other financial institutions must report to the tax authorities on financial matters and insurance, among other things deposit and loan accounts, holdings in funds, financial instruments and other financial products, insurance and pension arrangements, showing balances or values, returns, payments, acquisitions and disposals. The information must be given for each account holder, authorised user, investor, policyholder, recipient of payments and beneficial owner.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Identify account holders, including their tax residence, as the reporting rules require

titles.en: Identify account holders, including their tax residence, as the reporting rules require

summaries.en: Firms with the reporting duty must identify account holders and the other persons they report on, following the procedure set in the ministry's regulation, which can include obtaining a self-certification of tax residence and may bar opening a new account without it.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Investigate arrangements that seem designed to avoid international tax information exchange

titles.en: Investigate arrangements that seem designed to avoid international tax information exchange

summaries.en: If a firm with the reporting duty has reason to believe that an account holder or another person has arranged matters to avoid information being exchanged under a treaty with a foreign state, it must investigate to confirm or dispel the suspicion and, if it cannot dispel it, report the information it has, including the circumstances behind the suspicion.

instruments.title: Add Verdipapirsentralloven, LOV-2019-03-15-6
instruments.sourceLabel: Lovdata, LOV-2019-03-15-6, Lov om verdipapirsentraler og verdipapiroppgjør mv. (verdipapirsentralloven), consolidated text

titles.nb: Lov om verdipapirsentraler og verdipapiroppgjør mv. (verdipapirsentralloven)
titles.en: Act on Central Securities Depositories and Securities Settlement etc. (Central Securities Depositories Act)

payload.implementsNote: CSDR, Regulation (EU) No 909/2014, made Norwegian law by § 1-1; Shareholder Rights Directive (EU) 2017/828

obligations.title: Add the duty: As an account operator, keep securities accounts compliant and offer account segregation choices

titles.en: As an account operator, keep securities accounts compliant and offer account segregation choices

summaries.en: An account operator is responsible for the securities accounts and financial instruments it operates always meeting the requirements of law, regulation and the central securities depository's rules. It must meet the CSDR duties on the integrity of the issue, on not creating securities, and on offering the different account types with information on their levels of protection and costs, and must have clear and accessible arrangements for handling complaints.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep documentation of the basis for register entries for at least ten years

titles.en: Keep documentation of the basis for register entries for at least ten years

summaries.en: An account operator must keep documentation of the basis for the registrations it makes in the securities register for at least ten years.

instruments.title: Add Gjeldsinformasjonsloven, LOV-2017-06-16-47
instruments.sourceLabel: Lovdata, LOV-2017-06-16-47, Lov om gjeldsinformasjon ved kredittvurdering av privatpersoner (gjeldsinformasjonsloven), consolidated text

titles.nb: Lov om gjeldsinformasjon ved kredittvurdering av privatpersoner (gjeldsinformasjonsloven)
titles.en: Act on Debt Information in Credit Assessments of Private Individuals (Debt Information Act)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report customers' unsecured debt and unused credit limits to debt information companies

titles.en: Report customers' unsecured debt and unused credit limits to debt information companies

summaries.en: A financial undertaking must report, or otherwise make available, debt information to the licensed debt information companies, meaning information on an individual's debt or unused credit limit that is not secured by a registered mortgage on the person's assets, as detailed in the ministry's regulation.

instruments.title: Add Forskrift om risikostyring og internkontroll, FOR-2008-09-22-1080
instruments.sourceLabel: Lovdata, FOR-2008-09-22-1080, Forskrift om risikostyring og internkontroll, consolidated text

titles.en: Regulation on Risk Management and Internal Control

obligations.title: Add the duty: Make the board ensure appropriate risk management and internal control
obligations.sourceLabel: Lovdata, forskrift om risikostyring og internkontroll (FOR-2008-09-22-1080) § 3

titles.en: Make the board ensure appropriate risk management and internal control

summaries.en: The board must ensure that the firm has appropriate systems for risk management and internal control, including a clear allocation of responsibilities, goals and strategy with a defined risk profile, principles for risk management and compliance with laws and regulations, and must follow up their implementation. The arrangements must be proportionate to the nature, scale and complexity of the business.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Review the material risks of every business area at least once a year
obligations.sourceLabel: Lovdata, forskrift om risikostyring og internkontroll (FOR-2008-09-22-1080) § 6

titles.en: Review the material risks of every business area at least once a year

summaries.en: The firm must continuously assess the material risks of its business and, based on its goals and strategies, review the material risks of all business areas at least once a year, assessing whether its risk management and internal control handle them soundly. The assessments must be documented.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the board a yearly overall assessment of the risk situation
obligations.sourceLabel: Lovdata, forskrift om risikostyring og internkontroll (FOR-2008-09-22-1080) § 8

titles.en: Give the board a yearly overall assessment of the risk situation

summaries.en: The chief executive must, at least once a year, prepare an overall assessment of the firm's risk situation and present it to the board for consideration.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Have an internal audit function or an annual independent confirmation from the auditor
obligations.sourceLabel: Lovdata, forskrift om risikostyring og internkontroll (FOR-2008-09-22-1080) § 9

titles.en: Have an internal audit function or an annual independent confirmation from the auditor

summaries.en: Payment institutions, e-money institutions and regulated markets must have internal audit. A firm without internal audit must have its chosen auditor give the board an annual confirmation on its risk assessments, controls and documentation.

instruments.title: Add Forskrift om meldeplikt ved utkontraktering av virksomhet mv., FOR-2021-09-15-2777
instruments.sourceLabel: Lovdata, FOR-2021-09-15-2777, Forskrift om meldeplikt ved utkontraktering av virksomhet mv., consolidated text

titles.nb: Forskrift om meldeplikt ved utkontraktering av virksomhet mv.
titles.en: Regulation on the Duty to Notify Outsourcing of Activities etc.

payload.shortName: Forskrift om meldeplikt ved utkontraktering av virksomhet mv.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep an up-to-date overview of all outsourcing agreements
obligations.sourceLabel: Lovdata, forskrift om meldeplikt ved utkontraktering av virksomhet mv. (FOR-2021-09-15-2777) § 1

titles.en: Keep an up-to-date overview of all outsourcing agreements

summaries.en: Every firm under Finanstilsynet's supervision must keep an up-to-date overview of all its agreements to outsource activities.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Include the prescribed details when notifying critical or important outsourcing
obligations.sourceLabel: Lovdata, forskrift om meldeplikt ved utkontraktering av virksomhet mv. (FOR-2021-09-15-2777) § 3

titles.en: Include the prescribed details when notifying critical or important outsourcing

summaries.en: The notification duty under finanstilsynsloven § 4-6 covers agreements to outsource activities that are critical or important for the firm, and each notification must contain the details the regulation lists, starting with the service provider's name and organisation number and the activity outsourced.
